title: Adding a required column to a live table

concepts.description: A schema change is split into steps that each work with the code both before and after it: add nullable, backfill, then tighten.
concepts.context: 0042_users_region.sql adds region as nullable first and only enforces it after the backfill

concepts.description: Updating a large table in bounded batches keeps each transaction short, so locks and replication lag stay small.
concepts.context: the UPDATE in 0042_users_region.sql touches 5000 ids per statement and is repeated

concepts.description: CONCURRENTLY builds an index without blocking writes, at the cost of a slower build and not being allowed inside a transaction.
concepts.context: users_region_idx is created CONCURRENTLY, outside the BEGIN/COMMIT block, so inserts to users keep flowing

concepts.description: Adding a constraint NOT VALID enforces it for new rows without scanning the table, and VALIDATE then checks old rows under a weaker lock.
concepts.context: users_region_set is added NOT VALID and validated separately instead of using SET NOT NULL
